desc: The Cloak Tuck IWB Holster is above the rest in terms of comfort, concealment and adjustability to fit the holster to the wearer. This IWB holster is designed from the ground-up to deliver all day comfort for concealed carry, with a durable, flexible holster base and a secure custom-molded retention shell. Along with the Cloak Tuck IWB holster, this product includes a 30 Day Test Drive trial period as well as our Iron-Clad Program that means we will keep your holster in working use for life! Alien Gear Holsters are proudly made in the USA.
